Name: Portable Workbench
Author: NoonIsTaken
Description:
[code][url=https://billing.kinetichosting.net/aff.php?aff=1116][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/186444873-1753361291.png[/img][/url][/code]

The Portable Workbench mod allows players to access their workbench from anywhere in the game using a convenient keybind.
This feature enhances gameplay by eliminating the need to return to a specific location to craft items,
making it easier to manage resources and create tools on the go.

Key Features:[list]
[*]Accessibility: Use your workbench from any location in the game world.
[/list][list]
[*]Keybind Functionality: Quickly access crafting options with a simple keypress (Default keybind: V).
[*]Ability to cycle through all your placed workbenches using SHIFT + V (Or your own keybind if you changed it!)
[*]Config for keybind, works ingame with GMCM
[/list][list]
[*]Compatibility: Should work with any inventory connecting mod you have for your workbench, and has support for Better Crafting
[*]Incompatibility: BetterCrafting: Magic Workbench
[*]Untested in multiplayer
[/list]Installation:
Simply download the mod and place the PortableWorkbench folder in your mods folder.
To uninstall simply remove the PortableWorkbench folder from your mods folder
